OppSalesMethodologyItem.name: OppSalesMethodologyItem
OppSalesMethodologyItem.description: Represents the scored criteria for an opportunity's associated sales methodology.

IsLocked.description: Indicates if the opportunity's sales methodology criteria is locked (true) or not (false).

MayEdit.description: Indicates whether a user can edit the opportunity's sales methodology criteria.

Name.description: The name of the opportunity's sales methodology stage or criteria.

Note.description: This field stores details you enter when updating or scoring the opportunity's sales methodology stage or criteria.

OppSalesMethodologyId.description: Required. The ID of the opportunity's sales methodology.

SalesMethodologyDefItemId.description: Required. The ID of the sales methodology stage or criteria.

Value.description: The value associated with the opportunity's scored sales methodology stage or criteria.

OppSalesMethodologyItem.accessRules: To access this object turn on the userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled, OrgPreferences, SalesMethodologyPref, and PipelineInspectorUser permissions. To create, edit, or delete records, users must own the associated opportunity's parent opportunity.
